plainTranslation: Their movement toward unfamiliar growth lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making you more aware of ways you could show up differently.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their movement toward unfamiliar growth lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making you more aware of ways you could show up differently.
summaryDeep: Their movement toward unfamiliar growth lands directly on how you present yourself and enter situations, making you more aware of ways you could show up differently. Around them, a less familiar approach to entering situations or presenting yourself may feel more relevant than usual. The contact can point toward development, but it is not proof of destiny or a path you are required to follow.
